top_story.title: SpaceX Stock Plunges Despite Getting 2 Big Price Targets
top_story.summary: SpaceX  stock fell Thursday for a second straight day.  Shares of Elon Musk’s AI-rocket business were off 10.1% at $172.50 in midday trading, after starting 1% up in premarket trading.  The  fell 1.3% after the Federal Reserve held interest rates steady and retail sales numbers showed some discretionary spending weakness.
